attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `cutA` to `dicD`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 95 to 99% of them, fewest at column 1, `dsbD`, 95%.

**Then columns 4 to 8**, `cadB` to `ghoT`, are [[lysine decarboxylation and transport]], carried by 85 to 86%. Through columns 47 to 49 a branch of 3 shell families runs in 12 to 14%, and through columns 53 to 58 a branch of 6 shell families runs in 12 to 19%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 98 against 85%, and hesitates less there, 0.06 against 0.73 bits. It hesitates most at column 3, `cadC`, a fork column, 2.48 bits.

**The last column is `uvrA`**, in 44% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 86% of genes**, 0.70 bits on average, perplexity 2.1 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.80 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 67% against 94%.

label: cutA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the cutA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cutA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,983 to 4,062 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cutA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 86% of genes, 0.70 bits on average (perplexity 2.1 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,080 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; shell 13,580 calls, named 74%, 1.43 bits; cloud 1,460 calls, named 14%, 4.17 bits. Outside an RGP 29,720 calls, named 94%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 13,400 calls, named 67%, 1.80 bits. Columns: 3 spine, 21 fork, 56 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.80 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (67% against 94%); 13,400 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 3 (cadC, a fork column) 2.48 bits, RGP 93%; column 4 (cadB, a variable column) 1.68 bits, RGP 93%; column 17 (melB, a variable column) 1.36 bits, RGP 30%. The 14 columns (columns 3-7 and 45-53) where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.95 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 86%, 0.65 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 3 spine columns: named 98%, 0.06 bits on average; the 77 fork and variable columns: named 85%, 0.73 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 3, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: cutA, dsbD, dicD. named 95-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 1 (dsbD), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.10 bits (column 1 (dsbD)).
[S2] 2. columns 3-79 (77 columns) fork and variable columns: share 4-88%, 60 P, 17 S, RGP 12-93%. named 43-93% (mean 85%), fewest named at column 20, named 43%; most hesitant at column 3, 2.48 bits.
